reviews.text: Un produit qui est très efficace. La peau est parfaitement protégée. Elle reste douce, hydratée, zéro tiraillement. Je n'ai aucune réaction allergique malgré ma peau très réactive. Je recommanderai ce produit sans hésitation.
reviews.zh: 呢款產品好有效。皮膚保護得好好，保持柔順、水潤，完全冇緊繃感。我嘅皮膚好容易敏感，但用完冇出現任何過敏反應。我會毫不猶豫咁推薦呢款產品。

reviews.text: Not sure if it's helping my dark circles, but I find this nourishing, great lightweight texture. Haven't experienced irritation I really like the design of the packaging - they've designed it in a way so that the bottle always seems filled with air, which makes squeezing the product out super easy (no need to do the whole toothpaste tube squeeze to get every last drop).
reviews.zh: 唔確定對黑眼圈有冇幫助，但覺得佢好滋潤，質地好輕盈。冇出現過刺激感。我好鍾意個包裝設計，佢令瓶入面好似一直都有空氣，所以擠出產品好容易（唔使好似擠牙膏咁要擠到最後一滴）。

reviews.text:
this eye cream is very good; its soothing, calming, hydrating, but it doesn't really do anything special for me. It does have some scent, a floral scent which is pleasant, but I generally don't like scent ... 
but it hydrates well!
reviews.zh:
呢款眼霜好好，舒緩、鎮靜、補濕都做得到，但對我嚟講冇乜特別效果。佢有少少香味，係花香，幾好聞，不過我一般都唔太鍾意有香味……
但係補濕效果好好！

reviews.text: i'm looking for a lightweight eyecream, that's why i came across this. however, it really disappointed me because for the first time i use an eyecream that make my eyes sting. i tried to apply it not close to my eye but somehow it still stings when i wake up. i also use other thicker eyecream from a Japan brand but have no such problem
reviews.zh: 我想搵一款輕盈嘅眼霜，所以先會揀到呢款。不過佢令我好失望，因為呢個係我第一次用眼霜之後眼睛會刺痛。我嘗試唔好塗近眼睛，但起身嗰陣眼睛仍然會刺痛。我另外用緊一隻日本品牌嘅較厚身眼霜，就冇呢個問題。

reviews.text: The product is very good. It has a subtle calendula aroma. The texture is also very good, it gets absorb very fast and it doesn't leave any trace. Sometimes I apply it twice. The only thing I don't like is that the tube is very big and that it can't stand vertical. I don't have much space in the toilette so It's not that convenient.
reviews.zh: 產品好好，有淡淡嘅金盞花香味。質地都好好，吸收得好快，唔會留低任何痕跡。有時我會塗兩次。我唯一唔鍾意嘅係支裝太大，而且唔可以直立擺放。我個洗手間冇乜位，所以唔太方便。

reviews.text: Great, smooth, hydrating and cooling gel formula that is easy to work with and comfortable on the skin! The packaging is way bigger than you might expect for an eye cream- and so I can really see it lasting me ages! You're definitely getting your money's worth! Definitely great for young, dry skin!
reviews.zh: 好好、順滑、補濕又帶涼感嘅啫喱配方，易推開，搽喺皮膚上好舒服！包裝比一般眼霜嘅尺寸大好多，所以我真係覺得可以用好耐！絕對物有所值！好啱年輕、乾性皮膚！

reviews.text: Been using this product for 1-2 weeks now and am already seeing results. Nothing major in the sense of 'all wrinkles will be gone'. But my finer lines have truly smoothed out. Combining this with other skin care regiment is a true recommendation!
reviews.zh: 用咗呢款產品一兩個星期，已經見到效果。唔係話『所有皺紋都會消失』咁大嘅改變，但我嘅細紋真係平咗好多。同其他護膚步驟一齊用，真係值得推薦！

reviews.text: this product caught my attention through a korean skin care video on youtube. And since i'm quite new to korean skin care and it was recommended, I thought I might give it a try. And I'm really amazed by how good it is! My skin is really sensitive so I have trouble finding products that dont irritate my skin. but i trid this one and it felt really good, didnt irritate my skin and the skin around my eyes felt really hydrated.
reviews.zh: 呢款產品係我喺 YouTube 一條韓國護膚影片入面見到嘅。我對韓國護膚都仲係新手，又有人推薦，所以諗住試吓。真係令我好驚訝佢咁好！我嘅皮膚好敏感，好難搵到唔刺激嘅產品，但我試咗呢款，用落感覺好好，冇刺激皮膚，眼周嘅皮膚都感覺好水潤。

note: 以下評價由 YesStyle 顧客撰寫，OUJI 原文引用、只加中文翻譯，冇改動內容，亦冇刪走負評。只顯示我哋有貨嘅色號，同價錢有關嘅評價唔會收錄（兩邊售價唔同）。
